channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Breaking down Iran's UN speech after Trump's "annihilate" threat
item.description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian addressed the United Nations General Assembly a day after President Trump's speech that included threats against Iran.

item.title: Iran live updates: President responds to Trump at UN
item.description: After President Donald Trump threatened to "annihilate" Iran at the U.N. General Assembly, Iran's president used the same podium to respond.

item.title: Hurricane Polo a Category 4 storm off Mexico
item.description: Hurricane Polo rapidly strengthened in the Pacific off Mexico's southwestern coast, reaching Category 5 before easing to a Category 4.

item.title: Ambassador's son critically hurt in West Bank attack
item.description: Neria Leiter, son of Israel's ambassador to the U.S., Yechiel Leiter, was seriously injured in a car-ramming attack in the West Bank.
